dict.string: Sparrow reads the title of the active window so you can ask about it.
Sparrow controls apps you ask it to, like Spotify, Music, Mail and your terminal.
Sparrow uses your location to tell you the weather where you are.

Sparrow saves and finds phone numbers when you ask, like "save this number as Ali".
Sparrow looks through the camera only when you ask, like "Sparrow, what do you see?" or "take a photo".
Sparrow listens when you hold the voice shortcut so you can talk to it.
Sparrow turns your voice into text on your Mac.
Sparrow shows your next meetings in Today at a glance.
Sparrow shows and adds your to-dos.
Sparrow shows the battery of your AirPods and other Bluetooth devices.
